task: regression: peptide half-life as log10(half-life in seconds)
architecture: mean of 5 cluster-fold XGBRegressor models (reg:squarederror, enable_categorical=True); no full-data refit
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over every attended token including BOS/EOS, sequence passed as given (uppercase standard residues)
feature_order: desc_length, desc_net_charge, desc_pI, desc_hydrophobicity (modlAMP HydrophRatio), desc_hydrophobic_moment (Eisenberg), desc_aromatic_fraction, desc_cationic_fraction (K/R/H)
species, matrix, vivo_vitro (pandas category; integer codes follow the sorted level order below)

training_data.sources: PEPlife and DRAMP, merged and de-duplicated on (molecule_id, PMID)
training_data.residues: 20 uppercase standard amino acids only; D-form and non-standard sequences excluded
training_data.filters: censor_status == exact; named-enzyme rows dropped; matrix x vivo_vitro |z| > 3 outliers dropped
training_data.cv: 5 folds by CD-HIT cluster (40% identity), whole clusters per fold, greedy size-balanced assignment

cv_metrics.source: pipeline_esm2_150m.ipynb, out-of-fold predictions of the saved fold models
